title: Deputy Murders Rabbit on Camera After Pulling Taser on Coworker
description:
Bodycam and internal footage from Grant County, New Mexico reveal a disturbing late-night incident involving former deputy Alejandro Gomez. What began as playful horseplay over a baby rabbit quickly escalated when Gomez allegedly pointed a taser at a fellow deputy and then violently threw the animal into a patrol car, killing it. Investigators later learned Gomez had also pointed firearms at coworkers in separate incidents. Gomez was arrested on four counts of aggravated assault on a peace officer and one count of extreme cruelty to animals. While the assault charges were later dismissed, the animal cruelty case remains open. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
